was referred by a doctor Girkin to the mental health team at Haymills House .\nI had just lost my 97 year old mother , who suffered a horrendous end to her life\nConsequently , I have barely slept since . My mother died 3 months ago . An appointment was made for me to be assessed . I was monitored by a lady called Sarah who took notes on my mental health . She came to visit je at home twice . The first time , she said I desperately needed sleeping pills and therapy.  The second time , all that had changed , and she said that the team had decided that I was not in need of therapy , but just needed sleep . She said that she had written a letter to the aforementioned doctor to ask for Zopiclone . He refused and offered Melatonin . Now this is a drug that is used to reset the sleep cycle . I had already discussed with the nurse how I wasn't sleeping , and that sometimes I sat up all night . Talk about poor communication between the professionals who were meant to be dealing with my welfare  . Then she told me that she would ask the psychiatrist st the mental health centre to prescribe something , and that she would let me know the outcome . She never even bothered to contact me again ; infact I had been dumped . The doctor concerned , told me that he would contact me on Friday 13th but never did . So , I am still sleep deprived , have developed IBS , have high blood pressure and am worried about my mental state . I hope the parties concerned are reprimanded for this disgusting scenario and that they regret their lack of interest in me when I suffer a stroke or breakdown . A sad state of affairs
